obligations: Keep each consequence conditional on its stated premises and distinguish the chosen codomain, aggregation/effect join, freshness protocols, control domain and topology.

Keep every argument conditional on its named instance premises and retain the linked body as the sole deciding owner. Pillar contributions describe the preserved relationship and do not imply universal derivation. Required separation and any contributor-disclosure duty remain choices of the applicable governing contract.

premises.binding: Applicable subsets and instance premises are stated separately in each source_table_scope row.

argument.conditional_consequence: Each stated instance premise supplies a decision-specific consequence: recoverable meaning, purpose-bound interfaces, current subject identity, supported material joins, separate truth/performance/effects, non-promoting refinements, retained failures and coverage, sufficient reacquisition, observed or lawfully idempotent retry, preserved outer outcomes, and adequate allocation without a prescribed hierarchy. These arguments do not derive their owners policy choices from finite capacity.
policy_choices: Core owns five verdicts, performance/effect coordinates and conjunction precedence; domain owners choose evidence/freshness/replay/control policies; profiles choose topology.

argument.standing: author conditional argument; no independent entailment proof

rows: [Interpretation and representation](#interpretation-and-representation), applied by Faithful projection, AC-017 and RF-017
F2 interprets an encoding; F4 preserves the consumer's material relations. Information and interpretation, and axiomatic calculus, contribute recoverable meaning where a view stands for source.
Equal syntax or a valid map cannot establish that a consumer recovers the same permission, failure or unresolved condition. Fidelity evaluates that source-to-consumer relation.
The source owns meaning; the projection contract selects exactness or an admitted approximation and its end-to-end bound. No universal encoding or decidability claim follows.
[Purpose and interfaces](#purpose-and-interfaces), applied by UP-013 and UP-014
F1 supplies a selected outcome; F4 relates a local interface to that outcome. Specification and project structure supply the requiring relation; functional design supplies the bounded interface.
A local successful operation cannot define the Product outcome or justify its own burden. The interface must serve a material relation of the selected outer contract.
The purpose owner selects adequacy; Spec Method owns outcome conservation and proportional burden. Neither a signature nor finite capacity supplies those value choices.
[Identity, state and evidence](#identity-state-and-evidence), applied by Identity Method and result reuse

F3 distinguishes scoped identity and changing state; F2 binds an observation to its subject. World models and identity contribute object boundaries; evidence and correction distinguish current support from historical observation.
A digest proves selected bytes, not shared identity, current state or acceptance. A reused result needs its material subject and support to remain applicable.
Identity Method owns governed coordinates; domain owners choose observation and currentness protocols. This argument establishes no Markov property or universal replay requirement.
[Typed composition](#typed-composition-and-conservation) and [Orthogonal descriptions](#orthogonal-descriptions), applied by Composition law and AC-016

F4 requires compatible typed joins; F2 separates preserved meaning from a mathematical model. Algebraic calculus and functional design contribute composition; computational execution contributes the effect laws needed by a rewrite.

Local conformance does not establish the composite, and regrouping does not license reordered or parallel effects. A categorical claim additionally needs its declared objects, equality, identities and composition proof.

The composite owner selects the outer predicate and admitted loss; the execution binding supplies any independence equations. The categorical claimant owns the demonstration; matching outputs do not supply it.
[Judgment and authority](#judgment-and-authority), applied by Bind, Contract application, Dispose and domain authority rules

F2 distinguishes a claim from its evidence; F6 distinguishes that support from the owner's actual grant. The instance supplies the governed subject, effect or decision and the granting relation. Specification supplies owners; evidence and authority preserve their distinct responsibilities.

Capability, a successful judgment or a selected role cannot authorize an otherwise ungranted effect or disposition. Delegation preserves the grant's limits; an owner decision and an evaluation remain different results.
The existing authority owners select grants, delegation and reserved decisions. Domain contracts supply their local identities and additional limits; this shared law appoints no actor or profile.
[Independent assessment](#independent-assessment), applied by Evaluate, Ticket UP-007, Spec assessment and evidence reuse

F2/F6 bind the claim to its actual support and assessor. The instance supplies a governing requirement for independent assurance; evidence and correction distinguish an author's self-check from that assurance.
A contribution adopted into the subject defeats a required nonauthor claim on that contribution. A counterexample alone need not do so; unaffected judgments and evidence keep their supported scope.

The governing contract selects the review boundary, required separation and any contributor-disclosure duty. Domains retain additional exposure, trace and promotion policies; no universal review count, model family or extra review stage follows.
[Result algebra](#result-algebra), applied by RF-012 and Evaluate

F1 selects the predicate; F2/F6 bind its evidence; F3/F5 admit interruption and uncertain effects. Information preserves the original claim; computational execution distinguishes performance and effects from truth.
A completed effect can accompany a failed outcome; a performed evaluation can remain undecidable; independent counterevidence can defeat a predicate without inventing performance.
This member selects five verdicts and separate performance/effect coordinates with their evidence conditions. Domain owners select admissible evidence and observation boundaries.
Domain refinement and decision results in [Result algebra](#result-algebra), applied by Work result, RF-012 and Dispose
F2 retains each domain's meaning; F6 separates evidence from decision authority. Information and interpretation preserve the reason-qualified outcome; evidence and authority preserve the mandate.
`candidate_ready` can establish availability only. A refined label without its deciding reason supplies no fitness or acceptance judgment; a lawful disposition is a separate predicate.
The domain owner selects its outcomes, predicates and total reason-sensitive mapping. The mandate owner selects permitted dispositions; the core never supplies missing authority.
[Result conjunction](#result-conjunction), applied by Conjoin, frame conjunction and engagement coverage

F2 authenticates each claim; F4 preserves the declared required predicates and joins; F6 prevents unsupported promotion. Algebraic calculus supplies one combination rule; evidence and correction retain counterexamples and uncovered obligations.

A known required failure survives missing coverage. Received results cannot define away an absent required slot, and a composite cannot report effect absence merely because its combining operation is pure.

This member selects aggregation precedence and the join over normalized effect parts. Applicability owners supply required coverage; another declared operator owns its different predicate and proof obligations.
[Workspace and context](#workspace-and-context), applied by Acquire, Recovery law and ticket resumption

F3 supplies persistent state; F2 makes an actor's account revisable; F5 bounds acquisition. World models and identity supply the continuing subject; reference frames and information supply its task-specific view.
Losing context does not erase work. Absence from a projection proves no absence in the subject; changed material support reopens affected reliance while independent valid progress remains usable.
Domain owners select freshness, concurrency and any stronger replay rules; the execution binding selects measurements. Context fit and actual-use adequacy retain separate evidence.
Unknown-effect recovery in [Workspace and context](#workspace-and-context), applied by Recovery law and Transform

F3 permits effects to persist beyond observation; F2/F6 forbid invented completion or permission. Outcome-driven development contributes continuation from observed state; computational execution contributes actual effect boundaries.
A lost acknowledgment does not justify an effect-free restart. Before a dependent repeat, reconcile enough state or establish the actual operation's granted idempotence.
The operation owner supplies observation, retry and repair permissions; the domain supplies its idempotence law. No universal transaction, reset or retry strategy follows.
[Bounded construction](#bounded-construction), applied by UP-020 and Design's totality rule

F1 supplies destination constraints; F3 supplies changing work; F4 conserves outer obligations; F5 bounds an activation. Specification refines the destination; outcome-driven development and functional design supply bounded transitions and control.
Refinement must preserve material joins. A truthful stop or useful discovery can occur without completing the destination; changing the destination cannot prove the old one reached.

Spec Method owns Product progress and re-entry; the selected control domain bounds handling and Design retains its totality preference. Actual grants bound continuation, repair, recovery, yield and termination. The foundation guarantees no universal solution.
Strategy and feedback in [Bounded construction](#bounded-construction), applied by Spec intake, work selection and recovery

F1 supplies required conditions; F2 distinguishes their meaning from prediction; F3 supplies observed reality; F5 bounds work; F6 bounds response. The instance supplies its outcome, fallible models and material resource/feedback tradeoffs. Specification, world modelling and outcome-driven development contribute comparison and correction on those distinct accounts.

A prediction error does not choose a repair or decide outcome satisfaction. Diagnose the supported discrepancy and choose useful authorised work within required assurance; a changed target cannot close the former one.

The admitted work authority selects strategy; domain owners select causal models, measurements and additional risk policy. The requirement owner alone changes required conditions; a bug label supplies no authority.
[Construction assurance](#construction-assurance), applied by Evaluate, Conjoin and the testing/closure consumers

F1 binds the intended claim; F2 interprets its support; F4 preserves required joins; F6 separates evidence and authority. Evidence and correction connect the source obligation to the actual consuming decision.
A pass, formula or combined result supplies only the claim its justification establishes. The consumer binds the applicable assurance relations before dependent reliance.
Domain policy selects required assurance and admissible evidence; the existing result algebra supplies conclusions. No additional stage, role or record follows.
[Preservation obligations](#preservation-obligations), applied by Composition law and complete-transition assessment

F2 binds the interpreted state/trace predicates; F4 preserves the outer contract. The instance supplies transition relations, boundary properties and governing assumptions. Algebraic composition and functional design contribute compatible preconditions, postconditions and effects.

Initial conditions, each step, compatible joins and the final implication are required for the end-to-end claim. Local validity, an invariant or a sequential argument establishes no unsupported arrival, concurrency or execution-conformance claim.

The composite owner selects the properties and admissible loss; the execution binding supports conformance. Probability, induction or categorical claims require their separate mathematical premises and arguments.
[Assertions and observations](#assertions-and-observations), applied by Evaluate, testing oracles and acquired views

F1 selects the source obligation; F2 binds interpretation and assertions; F3 binds observations; F6 limits conclusions to support. The instance supplies the case domain, observation map and checker relation. Information and evidence contribute the distinctions needed to judge the predicate.

A necessary-condition pass cannot establish a sufficient conclusion. Indistinguishable cases with different truth defeat a sound complete decision from that observation alone; favourable runs cannot establish universal checker soundness.

The source owner fixes required meaning; the evaluation binding chooses its scope and instrumentation and supports actual conformance. A narrower scope needs justification; probability and computational feasibility require further models.
[Parallel assurance and provenance](#parallel-assurance-and-provenance), applied by independent assessment and evidence combination

F2 binds each assertion's meaning; F3 binds each execution's subject; F6 requires supported claims and any declared independence. The instance supplies the compared paths and their shared dependencies. Information, computation and evidence contribute distinct assertion and execution provenance.

Execution history cannot justify an expected predicate. Agreement can share a cause of error; disagreement requires diagnosis. Neither actor identity nor repeated evidence establishes independent upstream support.

Domain contracts select acceptable derivations and required authorship independence. The dependence model supports any statistical independence claim; model validation retains purpose and external-evidence owners.
[Risk and assurance selection](#risk-and-assurance-selection), applied by strategy, testing selection and acceptance conditions

F1 supplies the obligations and consequence criteria; F2/F6 restrict conclusions to justified evidence; F5 makes assurance consume finite resources. Quantitative instances additionally assume a stated probability model with supported priors, likelihoods and dependence. Computation and evidence contribute measured cost and calibrated observations.

More checks and multiplying miss rates cannot substitute for applicability and dependence. A numerical posterior or detection probability remains bounded by the selected model and never implies whole-product correctness without that separate claim.

Admitted work authority selects assurance within governing policy. The model supplies its probability assumptions; mathematical probability laws, not F1–F6 alone, justify the displayed identities. No universal threshold or mandatory quantification follows.
[Change impact and evidence retention](#change-impact-and-evidence-retention), applied by recovery, testing selection and closure reuse

F2 binds the claim and its support; F3 distinguishes original observation from changed state; F4 requires preserved dependencies; F6 retains required independence. The instance supplies the material change and supported dependency coverage. Identity, information and evidence contribute applicability on the new subject.

Missing edges cannot justify excluding affected work. Retain only justified evidence, add actual reassessment, preserve failures and assess new obligations and mandatory gates; selection alone proves no execution.

The tenant chooses the impact representation and strategy; owners supply obligations, gates and preservation relations. Cost optimisation cannot remove required assurance, and a changed hash supplies neither invalidity nor equivalence.
[Configuration](#configuration), applied by RF-009 and an adopted Baseline engagement

F4 supplies task dependencies; F5 bounds actors; F6 supplies grants; the instance supplies fallibility and assurance conditions. Reference frames allocate information; computational execution supplies actor capability and communication cost.
The allocation must retain dependencies and required independence within capability. Neither one actor, a hierarchy nor an Executive is derived from finite capacity alone.
The adopting Product, operational profile or tenant design selects allocation and reconfiguration. An adopted profile retains its own duties and prohibitions; selection grants no new authority.

obligations: Bind whether independent assessment is required and its authorship, evidence, reference-exposure, actor and configuration conditions. A required nonauthor assessor is not an author of the reviewed subject or repair. Self-review remains authoring evidence even after human acceptance.

A defect report, counterexample or identification of already-required behavior does not itself author a repair and may be rechecked. Adopted material wording, policy or design is authorship and cannot receive its contributor's required nonauthor assessment; unaffected judgments keep their scope. Additional separation and contributor-disclosure duties require the applicable governing contract. Changed subjects, tests or assessment conditions apply evidence-retention rules.

Shared sources/evidence are allowed only under required conditions. Actor identity, fresh context or model-family difference alone proves no independence. Keep statistical shared-cause assurance, frame disjointness, procedural independence and claim-relative nonauthor assurance distinct.
permissions_exceptions: No additional review boundary, contributor-disclosure duty, reviewer count or model family follows independently of the governing contract; governing domains retain their particular requirements.

argument.conditional_consequence: Where independent nonauthor assessment is required, adopted authorship cannot support that independent claim; reporting a counterexample alone need not author its repair.

A finding blocks current promotion only if it falsifies the bounded claim, exposes competing/ambiguous acceptance authority, violates active authority/safety/retained accepted behavior, or establishes durable architecture foreclosing an admitted Product outcome.
Record direct/lawfully proxied human rulings before the next affected acceptance boundary with source wording separate from interpretation; opening a ticket alone does not satisfy the ruling.
Under UP-020 bind selected basis, affected relation, construction/assessment authority and re-entry; ticket/admission cannot widen it or replace live-surface assessment.

UP-007 binds the shared nonauthor condition to its exact reviewed subject at required independent-review boundaries, preserving durable trace and promotion-blocking policy. No author of that subject or repair supplies its required independent assessment.

Apply [Independent assessment](FOUNDATIONS.md#independent-assessment) to the
reviewed claim and [Judgment and authority](FOUNDATIONS.md#judgment-and-authority)
to its assessment, operation and acceptance grants. UP-007 supplies the
applicable boundaries, durable trace and promotion-blocking policy below;
the governing owner selects required review and any reserved decision.

For UP-007's required independent reviews, apply that owner's nonauthor
condition to the exact reviewed subject. The review carrier identifies the
subject, basis, scope, exclusions, evidence, verdict and unresolved findings,
with the assessor's authorship and evidence conditions bound.
